cityFieldNotes: searchKey and aliases are optional trailing slots. searchKey is present only when it differs from name.toLowerCase(); when absent or empty, use name.toLowerCase(). aliases is an array of extra already-normalized search keys. Cities are sorted by searchKey inside each region, so a prefix range can be binary-searched.
normalize: Apply to the query before matching: NFKD, drop combining marks, map slashed/crossed letters (o-slash, d-stroke, l-stroke, ae, ss, eth, thorn) to ASCII, lowercase, delete apostrophes and periods, replace - _ / , ( ) with a space, collapse runs of whitespace, trim.
queryEquivalentsNote: Leading-token equivalences the client should try as a second probe (a query of "st cath" should also be searched as "saint cath" and vice versa). Not baked into the data: doing so would cost ~10 KB.
populationNote: Exact for 100000 and above; below that, rounded to two significant figures. Used for ranking only. 0 means GeoNames publishes no figure for a real place -- most are Canadian neighbourhoods such as Malton or Rexdale -- so rank 0 as if it were ~2000, not last.
